futuresMethod.text: Each rating blends a preseason rating with 2026 scoring. Preseason: 45% career form (recent and career win %, scoring vs. league, playoff finishes) + 55% post-draft roster (2026 draft ranks). 2026 scoring: points per game, pulled toward the league average while the sample is small; its share grows each week. After Week 6, preseason carries 71% of each rating and 2026 scoring 29%. The rest of the season is simulated 10,000 times on the real schedule; standings ties go to points for; six-team bracket, top two seeds get byes. Prices include a 5% house edge.
